summary: OpenTTD is a transport tycoon simulation game based upon a popular classic title. You construct and manage transport networks involving road, rail, air and water routes to move passengers and cargo across a map.
goodFor: Self-hosters looking to run a dedicated multiplayer server for friends or community members to build networks together.
watchOut: Running a dedicated multiplayer server requires managing network ports and potential state synchronization issues between clients and the host.
deployNotes: As a compiled C++ application wrapped in Docker, it typically requires persistent storage for game maps and saves, plus appropriate firewall configuration for incoming connections.
